verdict.rationale: Docs describe a default supervised mode where every action requires manual approval, gated actions route to Slack with approve/deny buttons and nothing runs until approved, with granular control to auto-approve specific tools/tasks; this directly matches human-in-the-loop reply approval before customer contact. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of the approval UI in practice, and no explicit example of a full draft-reply-for-approval workflow (examples focus on refunds/transfers rather than reply drafts specifically).
